summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Payment (SO) revision 3 (Officer Detail view, grouped W9 header, Transaction ID removal, CRUD + exports) via Playwright on the public preview URL as admin@example.com. All 8 requested scenarios PASSED. Verified: client list -> 'Arseas Security' client view aggregated table (SL, Officer Name, Address, SSC, W2, W9 DD, W9 Zelle, W9 Total, Total) with grand-total footer ($4749.00 matching John Doe's aggregate row); officer detail opens via BOTH the officer name link and the View action button; officer table has Date, W2, grouped 'W9' header with colspan=3 (Direct Deposit / Zelle Transfer / W9 Total) and Total (W2+W9); footer totals (2700/1599/450/2049/4749) exactly equal the sum of the 4 visible rows; Add Payment from officer detail with FIXED officer shows exactly 6 inputs (3 rows x Date+Amount) and NO Transaction ID field anywhere (verified via dialog inner HTML scan for 'Transaction ID'/'txn'); submitting 100/200/300 increased rows 4->5 and grand total by +600; Edit dialog pre-filled correctly (dates+amounts, officer fixed, no Transaction ID) and changing Zelle 300->500 recomputed row W9 Total=700, Total=800 and footer (+200); Delete removed only that dated entry and restored totals to 4749; Officer PDF and Excel exports both downloaded (Payment-John Doe.pdf/.xlsx); Add New Payment from client view used the searchable officer picker (no Transaction ID field) and adding $77 raised the client grand total 4749 -> 4826; client-level PDF/Excel exports and officer search filter also work; back navigation officer -> client -> client list works. Test data created during the run was cleaned up (final state restored to 4 entries / $4749).

issues: Date fields use the browser-native <input type="date"> picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover component used elsewhere in the app (inconsistent look across browsers)
No client-side validation: submitting the dialog with all three amounts empty/0 creates an empty dated entry (or an entry with no date at all) instead of showing a validation error
Cancel button in the dialog has no data-testid
Delete uses window.confirm() native dialog instead of the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere; not testable via data-testid

action_items: Optional: replace native date inputs in PaymentDialog with the shadcn Calendar component for consistency
Optional: add validation so a payment cannot be saved with all amounts blank/0 and no date
Optional: replace window.confirm delete with shadcn AlertDialog and add data-testid to the Cancel button
Unrelated/pre-existing: console warning 'WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/ws/dispatch failed: closed before the connection is established' fires on dashboard load
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentSOPage.js is 606 lines with 5 components in one file; consider splitting ClientList/ClientView/OfficerDetail/PaymentDialog into separate modules before it grows past 700 lines.
toPayload() sends amount: Number(c.amount) || 0 and date: null for empty rows, so an entirely blank submit still POSTs a record — validate in the UI (and/or backend) before create.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 2 payment entries for John Doe (2026-03-10 and 2026-04-01) and deleted both; DB state restored to the original 4 entries totalling $4749.00.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment (SO) UI fully verified in iteration 4: officer detail grouped W9 header, footer totals = row sums, add/edit/delete entry, officer+client PDF/XLSX exports, and confirmed Transaction ID field removed from all 3 dialog variants (fixed officer add, edit, client-view add with officer picker). Navigation is in-page React state (URL stays /dashboard/dispatch/payment-so); reach officer detail by clicking so-officer-name-<officer_id> or so-record-view-<officer_id>. Only cosmetic/validation nits remain (native date picker, no empty-form validation, window.confirm delete).
